headlines.text: Nasdaq snaps three-day losing streak and Tesla hits a record as October jobs report beats estimates despite unemployment rate rising
Chip stocks rebound sharply as Nvidia climbs 3.6% and AMD surges as much as 8.3% premarket following Thursday's brutal AI-driven selloff
ADP private payrolls beat forecasts with 86,000 jobs added versus 69,000 expected, signaling labor-market resilience ahead of the jobs report
Airbnb shares jump 11.7% after Q3 revenue and profit beat estimates, as the board authorizes a new $12 billion buyback
Nasdaq futures rise premarket as chip stocks stabilize following the steep AI-driven tech selloff
